source_message.text:
I expect a draft that does not take too much time.

Even a pencil sketch would be sufficient to provide a general idea of the new bathrooms, separation walls, and kitchen cabinets. Can you simply indicate where you would place 3 new bathrooms and 3 new kitchen cabinets? How would you divide the houses, and so on?

source_message.text: Using the information provided, we added sketches to the plan, with the analyses presented in the image. Once the work receives approval, the rest of the analyses will be completed and the digital plan file will be produced using Autocad.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that sketches and associated analyses were added to the plan.
